target_customer: Health systems and payers that run complex care programs
problem: Care teams cannot follow up with patients through long care journeys, so tasks and messages are manual and patients fall through gaps.
product_category: Care navigation and patient messaging automation

founders.name: Manav Sevak
founders.background_notes: YC page: lectured in medical informatics at Penn and Georgia Tech.

founders.name: Nisarg Patel
founders.background_notes: YC page: surgeon, health AI researcher and angel investor.

technical_complexity.rationale: Turning clinical workflows into messaging journeys with EMR integration is standard engineering with heavy integration and compliance work.

defensibility.rationale: Deep EMR integration and health system contracts create stickiness, though message automation is imitable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Commure acquired Memora in December 2024 to strengthen its care navigation and AI portfolio.

market_need_then: No dated demand evidence from 2018 was found; later coverage cites health system customers such as Virtua and Intermountain.

rebrands.why: Site now shows Memora is part of Commure; the sale prompted the change per the site banner.

brand_strength.rationale: Registered trademarks exist but no press about the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: Memora grew to 115 people by selling care journey automation to health systems, raised about $70M in two rounds in 2022 and April 2023 including health system investors, and was acquired by Commure in December 2024 for an undisclosed amount. Clinician founders and sustained health system sales drove growth, but the sale price is unknown so the outcome relative to $70M raised is unclear.
notes: Stage labels conflict: CB Insights calls the 2022 round Series A-II, search summaries of Axios call it Series B; the opened hcinnovation article gives no series label, so both are other. The 2022 date is year only: the YC page says February 2022 while Axios said last spring. Total raised per MedCity $80.5M, CB Insights $83M, so earlier rounds are missing. YC page text mentions a16z, GC. Competitor search found only current comparison pages, nothing dated 2018, so list empty.
